inputs.charges: line TEXT PRIMARY KEY, order_id TEXT NOT NULL, channel TEXT NOT NULL, business_date TEXT NOT NULL, currency TEXT NOT NULL, amount TEXT NOT NULL
inputs.packages: package TEXT PRIMARY KEY, order_id TEXT NOT NULL, units INTEGER NOT NULL
inputs.settlements: line TEXT PRIMARY KEY, package TEXT NOT NULL, channel TEXT NOT NULL, business_date TEXT NOT NULL, currency TEXT NOT NULL, amount TEXT NOT NULL
inputs.channel_mappings: version TEXT NOT NULL, source_channel TEXT NOT NULL, target_channel TEXT NOT NULL, effective_from TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (version, source_channel, effective_from)
inputs.allocation_rules: order_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, mode TEXT NOT NULL
inputs.allocation_weights: order_id TEXT NOT NULL, package TEXT NOT NULL, weight TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (order_id, package)

runtime.recon_runs: run_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, fingerprint TEXT NOT NULL, params TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, summary TEXT NOT NULL
runtime.recon_results: run_id TEXT NOT NULL, package TEXT NOT NULL, channel TEXT NOT NULL, business_date TEXT NOT NULL, currency TEXT NOT NULL, receivable TEXT, settled TEXT, difference TEXT, category TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (run_id, package, channel, business_date, currency)
runtime.recon_allocations: run_id TEXT NOT NULL, charge_line TEXT NOT NULL, order_id TEXT NOT NULL, package TEXT NOT NULL, weight TEXT NOT NULL, share TEXT NOT NULL, allocated TEXT NOT NULL, residual INTEGER NOT NULL, source_channel TEXT NOT NULL, channel TEXT NOT NULL, business_date TEXT NOT NULL, currency TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (run_id, charge_line, package)
runtime.recon_settlements: run_id TEXT NOT NULL, line TEXT NOT NULL, package TEXT NOT NULL, source_channel TEXT NOT NULL, channel TEXT NOT NULL, business_date TEXT NOT NULL, currency TEXT NOT NULL, amount TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (run_id, line)
